site_description: An interactive guide to compilers and interpreters, with Wahoo, a tiny Mushroom Kingdom language whose real compiler (written in Rust, targeting WebAssembly) runs in your browser.

nav.theme: Switch between light and dark theme

playground.dek_short: Write Wahoo, see every phase, run it.

footer.text: Text, figures and compiler handmade (with help from Claude Code): no frameworks, no trackers. Wahoo is a fan-made teaching language; Mario and the Mushroom Kingdom belong to Nintendo, and no game assets are used here.
footer.siblings: Sister sites: Math of AI · Math of Quantum · Calculus × Computing

sec.memory: one linear memory of 64 KiB pages

sec.data: the bytes of every text literal

pg.keys: Ctrl+Enter runs. Click an error to jump to it.

pg.pressRun: Press Run (or Ctrl+Enter) to play the level.

pg.inAddressBar: The link is in the address bar.
